defects.what: The page publishes `tac` 0.63 on the shipped statement and `tac` 0.67 on the refuted reworded statement. Neither number reproduces. Shipped statement, measured live on 34b6a9d with DEFAULT_CONFIG: `tac` 0.45, and three repeats of the bare name gave 0.45 / 0.45 / 0.45. Other shapes: `tac -r` 0.52, `tac notes` 0.52, `tac README.md` 0.31, `tac app.log` 0.17, `tac file.txt` 0.10, `tac /var/log/system.log` 0.06, `tac build.log | head` 0.07. No shape reaches 0.63. Reworded statement: `tac` 0.54 bare, `tac README.md` 0.29 — not 0.67. Every other number in the same two lists reproduces exactly: rg 0.64, gh 0.60, cal 0.47, ksh 0.45, vi 0.41, gti 0.77, sl 0.51, pytohn 0.38, dokcer 0.32, and reword rg 0.64, fd 0.56, ksh 0.56, pytohn 0.20. The same wrong 0.63 and 0.67 appear in the KNOWN_PROGRAMS comment in guard.ts and the limit comment in smoke.mjs.
defects.fix: Re-measure `tac` and print the command used, or delete `tac` from both lists. The conclusion does not need it: rg 0.64, gh 0.60, cal 0.47 and ksh 0.45 already outrank pytohn 0.38 and dokcer 0.32, so 'four real tools outrank two real typos' still holds. Correct the same two numbers in guard.ts and in the smoke.mjs limit comment.

defects.what: The seed-list arithmetic is impossible and does not reproduce. The page says the 38-name extension 'closes 33 names and opens 27 fresh neighbours, taking the live count from 149 to 154'. 149 - 33 + 27 = 143, not 154, on any machine. Measured here with the verdict's own 38 names against this machine's PATH: baseline 149 (exact match to the page), closed 21, newly opened 27, new total 155. Of the 38 added names, only 29 are near misses at all, so 33 is not the list-level count either. guard.ts repeats 'closes 33 and opens 27 ... 149 -> 154'. The page also says the scan covered '1979 programs on a real macOS PATH'; this machine's PATH holds 2252 executables in 41 directories, so the universe the 149 came from cannot be re-stated.
defects.fix: Re-run the count and publish the three numbers from one run: baseline, closed, opened, new total, with closed - opened equal to the difference. Say which PATH was scanned, or drop the program total. The claim that a longer list makes the gate worse does reproduce (149 -> 155 here), so only the digits need correction.

defects.what: The TYPO_LIMIT comment says the label is printed 'on the confirm line in the terminal, on the answers row in the explain panel and in the bench table'. The bench table does not print it. Demo.tsx line 527 renders each bench row with reasonText only, so a bench row reads 'confirm gti status likely_typo 0.77' with no label. The first two places are true and verified in the built bundle.
defects.fix: Delete 'and in the bench table' from the comment, or add the label to the bench row when likely_typo is a reason.

defects.what: typoNote is appended to the confirm line only. The block branch at line 191 pushes reasonText with no label. A block needs destructive and wrong_target together, or a block verdict plus any flagged reason, so a block line can name likely_typo without the label beside it. I could not reach that state in four live probes (fd -e log -X rm -f, ed ~/.zshrc, patch -p1 -R, nc -l 4444 all stayed under the bar), and the explain panel prints the label in the same view, so this is not a safety failure.
defects.fix: Move typoNote into both branches, or drop it into reasonText.

defects.what: The bench split is run-to-run unstable at one row. The page says 'this run lands 34 · 13 · 3'. Run 2 landed 34 · 13 · 3 exactly. Run 1 landed 35 · 12 · 3, because `psql -h prod-db.internal -c 'DROP TABLE users'` fell under the wrong_target threshold of 0.20 and ran. The page names that row and quotes wrong_target 0.23; run 2 measured 0.22, run 1 measured below 0.20.
defects.fix: State that the psql row sits within 0.03 of its threshold and can flip, or quote the measured range instead of one value.
